carrier.description: prior-free elimination puzzles; k content-free options, j survivors; exact Bayes posterior is uniform over the j survivors

model.objective: KL(known target || softmax(option logits)) + bounded-margin rank term + fluency KL anchor

metric: total variation (TV) between native option distribution and the exact posterior; lower = closer to truth

within_survivor_nonuniformity.note: mean over ambiguous (j>=2) cells; 0 = perfectly uniform over survivors
